title: Workbench
reference: repeat 2 { F1 repeat 2 { F1 turn_right } } def F1 { forward forward activate }
hints: Two rows of switches joined at one end. Every switch is the same two steps away.
Put the walk-and-switch in F1. Each half of the bench is F1, then twice F1 and a turn. A loop inside a loop covers it.
